about: Permutation nulls regenerated from (n_total, n_hits) alone with scripts/empirical_null.py (seed 42, 1000 permutations): no data needed. Hits are placed at fixed positions, so the exact draws differ slightly from the nulls drawn on each library's real label vector that the reported percentiles use (results/testbed_results.json); the comparison table shows the size of the difference.
